_about: Honours: standing above guild rank and titles, granted once every requirement holds, never lost. requires: rank (guild rank letter), titles (all held), honours (all held). grants: holdings (added to Standing; each dawn they yield daily_xp experience) and a flat bonus (same keys as a skill bonus). An honoured character's badge turns gold.

honours.name: Knight of the Courtyard
honours.about: Rank C and two titles: the guild knights you.

honours.name: Champion
honours.about: Rank B and the Duelist's title.

honours.name: Lord of the Vale
honours.about: Rank A and a knighthood: the vale is yours.
